report_tables.title: V1.1 SFT / DPO1 / DPO2 across all 12 evaluation cells
report_tables.title_zh: V1.1 三阶段全部12个评测单元
report_tables.note: All 12 cells are retained. Rates aggregate mutually exclusive in_dist/held_out strata by requested rooms; OOR is conditional on complete outputs and weighted by complete-room counts. The original study is explicitly diagnostic_only because input ordering/IDs inherit GT size/pose information. Improvements on ordinary rooms do not remove constrained-room regressions. No matched old-versus-clean training-data causal ablation was run.
report_tables.note_zh: 从冻结摘要中互斥in_dist/held_out加权，失败保留在率分母；OOR条件于完整输出。此项目原始次序/ID继承GT尺寸姿态信息，明确diagnostic_only。普通集提升不能掩盖带约束退步；cleaned与old数据的因果对照未做。

report_tables.title: V1.1 size and collision diagnostics by original stratum
report_tables.title_zh: V1.1 尺寸与碰撞诊断：原始分层全量
report_tables.note: Original stratum values are shown without pooling; unavailable held_out dev strata are omitted. Size IoU degradation and incomplete outputs are retained, along with raw/repaired collision diagnostics. Collision percentages follow the original frozen metric definitions; complete counts and requested denominators are shown separately. These are the diagnostic_only V1.1 input protocol, not the later arbitrary unknown-size task.
report_tables.note_zh: 逐个保留原始分层值，不跨层重算尺寸均值；不存在的dev held_out不列。尺寸IoU下降、未完整输出以及raw/repaired碰撞均保留。碰撞百分比沿用原冻结指标定义，完整数与请求分母另列。此为diagnostic_only的V1.1输入协议，不是后来任意unknown-size任务。

report_tables.title: V1.1 downstream examples, before and after clean DPO
report_tables.title_zh: V1.1 下游5房间：原版与clean final
report_tables.note: Five rooms and 313 object instances per version; these are downstream examples, not a large benchmark. repaired_valid does not require zero main collisions. Both versions mark mesh generation successful for four of five rooms. Reference checks also fail or contain unknowns on GT. These results are not an external free-layout method comparison.
report_tables.note_zh: 每版5房间/313实例，非大样本benchmark。repaired_valid不要求main碰撞为0；reference_check中GT也有unknown/失败。两版均4/5mesh生成标记成功；不可改称自由布局外部方法胜负。
